description: This Java class 'RenameComponents' reads a file specifying component name replacements and applies these replacements to source files within a specified directory, effectively renaming components across multiple files.

classes.name: RenameComponents
classes.description: A utility class for renaming components in source files based on a replacement request file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command-line arguments, reads the replacement request, and processes files in the source directory.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Reads a source file, applies replacements, and writes the result to a destination file.

methods.name: processLine
methods.description: Applies all replacements to a single line of code.

methods.name: processLine (overloaded)
methods.description: Replaces specific substrings within a line.

methods.name: readReplaceRequest
methods.description: Reads the replacement rules from a specified file and populates the replaceMap.

methods.name: assertFolder
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists and is a directory.
